title: Phase-Shifted Full Bridge Cascaded Control Tuning

sections.heading: Bandwidth ordering
sections.text: Inner current loop crossover: f_ci ~ fsw/10. Outer voltage loop crossover: f_cv ~ f_ci/5 to f_ci/3. The current loop controls the primary inductor current; the voltage loop regulates the output.

sections.heading: Duty-cycle loss
sections.text: The effective secondary duty cycle is less than the primary due to the phase-shift overlap. Account for this loss in the gain calculations: D_eff = D_pri - D_loss where D_loss depends on the leakage inductance and load current.

sections.heading: ZVS maintenance
sections.text: ZVS is maintained by the leakage inductance energy. At light load, the leakage energy may be insufficient for ZVS. The controller cannot fix this — it is a hardware limitation. If ZVS is lost at the operating point, efficiency drops.

sections.heading: Gain direction
sections.text: For the current loop: increase kp until the current tracks within one switching cycle. For the voltage loop: increase kp for transient response, increase ki for steady-state accuracy. Watch for instability near the ZVS boundary where the plant characteristics change.
